title: Fly Pet: your fly on your desktop

head.title: Fly Pet
head.lede: A tiny fly that lives on your desktop. It chats with you, tells you what your Trader Fly is doing, shares alpha calls, and coaches you in your games.

dl.note: Windows may warn that the app isn't signed yet: click "More info", then "Run anyway". The code is open source on GitHub.

desk.p: A small fly that walks around near where you put it, stays on top of your windows, sleeps at night and waves good morning. Grab it, toss it, feed it.

chat.p: Click the fly and talk to your Trader Fly or partner NFT: ask why it traded, tell it what to change. It only suggests: nothing changes until you approve it.

alerts.p: It reacts to its own buys and sells, gains and losses, and big $FLYAI moves, with a bubble and a notification if you want one.

alpha.p: The same calls as our Discord, right in its chat, with Watch, Chart and Copy buttons.

coach.p: Playing a game? Your fly finds it by itself and, when a pick, shop or level-up opens, tells you the best choice with its odds. Free hints every day; Coach mode watches all session with the Coach pass.

safe.p: You sign in with your wallet on flyaiworld.com: the app gets a pet key that can chat and change your fly's settings, never move money, and never asks for a seed phrase. The coach only looks at the one game window, and never touches your game.

coach.title: It suggests. You make every move.

start.title: Get started
start.s1: Download and open Fly Pet. The fly appears at the bottom of your screen.
start.s2: Click Connect and approve in your browser on flyaiworld.com.
start.s3: Pick which of your flies (or partner NFTs) lives on your desktop.
start.s4: Click the fly to chat. Playing a game? Tap "Coach mode" in its chat, or press Alt+Shift+C for a hint.
start.close: To close it: right-click the fly, or use its icon in the system tray.
